posts.title: i made a discord server!
posts.description: sorry to make another rss entry so soon, but after a little bit of work, i'm ready to launch my new little discord server! i thought it would be nice for like-minded people to gather and chat, and i want to meet more people like me. if that sounds neat, feel free to check it out! no need to stay for long, it'd be nice to have ya even if it's just for a quick visit :)
